name: build-radar
because: radar is the tech gate for vehicles, aircraft and naval
source:
rule build-radar {
  priority 570
  category economy exclusive
  because "radar is the tech gate for vehicles, aircraft and naval"
  do produce-radar
  require not is-rushed
  require not queue-busy(Building)
  require can-build-role(radar)
  require not has-role(radar)
  require not queue-producing-role(radar)
  require has-role(barracks) or has-role(war-factory)
  require power-excess >= 0
  require cash >= 1000
}

name: build-airfield
because: does not spend the war factory's money: an exclusive category picks the highest-priority rule whose condition HOLDS, so a cash gate keeps the dearer rule out of the running entirely and the category builds cheapest-first — the war factory outranks this by fifty points and in game 83 was built thirty-five points of game later
source:
rule build-airfield {
  priority 670
  category economy exclusive
  because "does not spend the war factory's money: an exclusive category picks the highest-priority rule whose condition HOLDS, so a cash gate keeps the dearer rule out of the running entirely and the category builds cheapest-first — the war factory outranks this by fifty points and in game 83 was built thirty-five points of game later"
  do produce-airfield
  require not is-rushed
  require not queue-busy(Building)
  require can-build-role(airfield)
  require not has-role(airfield)
  require power-excess >= 0
  require cash >= 500
  require has-role(war-factory) or cash >= 2520
  require has-role(service-depot) or cash >= 1700
}

name: build-service-depot

name: build-base-defense
condition: !QueueBusy("Defense") && PowerExcess() >= 0 && (CanBuildRole("pillbox") || CanBuildRole("camo_pillbox") || CanBuildRole("turret") || CanBuildRole("flame_tower") || CanBuildRole("tesla_coil")) && RoleCount("pillbox") + RoleCount("camo_pillbox") + RoleCount("turret") + RoleCount("flame_tower") + RoleCount("tesla_coil") < 9 && Cash() >= 420 && (HasRole("radar") || Cash() >= 1420) && (IncomeRate() > 0 || HasRole("refinery") || Cash() >= 1820) && (IncomeRate() > 0 || HasRole("war_factory") || Cash() >= 2440) && (IncomeRate() > 0 || HasRole("service_depot") || Cash() >= 1620) && (IncomeRate() > 0 || HasRole("radar") || Cash() >= 1420)

  priority 580
  category defense exclusive
  do produce-defense
  require not queue-busy(Defense)
  require power-excess >= 0
  require can-build-role(pillbox) or can-build-role(camo-pillbox) or can-build-role(turret) or can-build-role(flame-tower) or can-build-role(tesla-coil)
  require role-count(pillbox) + role-count(camo-pillbox) + role-count(turret) + role-count(flame-tower) + role-count(tesla-coil) < 9
  require cash >= 420 and (has-role(radar) or cash >= 1420) and (income-rate > 0 or has-role(refinery) or cash >= 1820) and (income-rate > 0 or has-role(war-factory) or cash >= 2440) and (income-rate > 0 or has-role(service-depot) or cash >= 1620) and (income-rate > 0 or has-role(radar) or cash >= 1420)
}
